description:
**This is a Promotional Oneshot for a Novel!**

19 year old, Choi Woogi fell in love with the outdated RPG game called "Justice".  
Now, as a 20 year old adult he's still devoted to fanboying over the game and keeping up his gaming lifestyle, it was a normal day.

[Chunghoon: no, i dont want to, tora is an old man LOL]  
[Chunghoon: im a lively twenty y.o]  
[Tora: age... is just a number]  
[Tora: i'm only 27... even the president can't stop my investment in you]  
[Tora: please lower your standards just this once]

He meets a popular game streamer named 'Tora', through a fixed party by fate. He also happens to receive an 'infinite dash' from him which no other gamer has, leading Woogi to a strange contract relationship with Tora.

While living an ordinary gamer life, our 'Limited Time Love' has begun!

**Original Novel:** [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3822000018) | [Kakao](https://page.kakao.com/content/59201121)
